recent.title: PROCESS FOR MILLING A KITCHEN SINK

patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "mila", 2026-09-17

profile_text.body:
Mila, the Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, is a nonprofit research institute based in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. Its profile record gives a founding year of 1993. The institute says it brings together researchers from Université de Montréal, McGill University, Polytechnique Montréal and HEC Montréal, and describes itself as a community of more than 1,400 researchers specializing in machine learning.

Its site lists several programs beyond research. One supports AI startups at any time of the year with resources and tailored support. Another, offered by Mila and the Public Policy Forum, is aimed at policy and decision makers, with a next cohort held in French on September 1-2, 2026, at Mila. A venture arm invests in founders working in deep tech, AI, and STEM. Research described on the site includes QueStER, a method for generative keyword-based retrieval that has a lightweight LLM produce a keyword query executed by BM25 and trains the rewriting policy with reinforcement learning, and a methodology using high spatial resolution (2 m) commercial satellite imagery to study shrub expansion in Arctic tundra.

The held record lists no products and no lawsuits for the institute.
